crew.name: Rex Vale
crew.history: Rex flew meal-packs for a Spur co-op until a Swarm probe tagged his convoy. He kept the Sparrow airborne and never went back to scheduled runs.

crew.name: Bolt
crew.quote: If it rattles, I named it.
crew.history: A scrap-yard chassis with three owners and one personality core that refuses a factory reset. Bolts talk while they weld. The welds hold.
